requirements.text: Affordable-housing FAR pathways (UAP-type district bonuses, MIH where mapped, and comparable program FARs) are IN SCOPE for the development calculations: the program computes them as a separate, clearly-labeled conditional scenario alongside the as-of-right result. Merely refusing or omitting the affordable pathway is not acceptable product behavior.
requirements.required_harness: Rule engineering + scenario presentation tasks in the D-045 sequence; deterministic tests per pathway; gates as contracted.
requirements.required_evidence: future bound task packets and gate reports

requirements.text: The presentation must keep the owner's 'big distinction' explicit: the as-of-right allowance and each program-conditional allowance are separate labeled results, each with its own rule trace, and each program scenario lists its required conditions (e.g. required affordable share / income levels) as conditions, so the user always sees what must be committed to obtain the larger envelope.
requirements.required_harness: UI/report tasks with component tests asserting separate labeling and condition lists.
requirements.required_evidence: future bound task packets and gate reports

requirements.text: Point of truth: every presented allowance derives from the evaluated deterministic rule result with Zoning Resolution provenance. PLUTO's residential-FAR and affordable-FAR reference columns are cross-checks and discovery aids only; they never substitute for, and are never silently promoted to, an evaluated allowance (consistent with the D-063 four-concept separation).
requirements.required_harness: Rule-result adapter guards already accepted in D-063 remain; new pathways use the same discipline.
requirements.required_evidence: future bound task packets and gate reports

requirements.text: Eligibility handling: conditions computable from official facts (zoning district, mapped program areas, lot characteristics) are computed deterministically; conditions that are developer commitments (providing the affordable share) are presented as explicit unmet-until-committed conditions. Neither class is ever assumed satisfied, and no program pathway is silently dropped when its conditions are unmet - it is shown with its conditions.
requirements.required_harness: Deterministic eligibility rules with positive/negative tests per condition class.
requirements.required_evidence: future bound task packets and gate reports

requirements.text: External fact to verify before rule authoring: the owner's statement that most New York residential sites are now eligible for the affordable bonus must be established from current official sources (ZR text as amended by City of Yes / UAP provisions, DCP materials) with effective dates and district scope - never relied on from the chat assertion. Findings feed the rule specifications and remain subject to G6 qualified legal review before any rule is published.
requirements.required_harness: official-source-researcher capture with print/PDF-class channels and sha256-pinned snapshots per the ZR capture standard.
requirements.required_evidence: research snapshots + source matrix in the bound research task

requirements.text: Sequencing: this pathway work lands in the established D-045/handoff-section-9 order - after the spatial-evidence repair and the as-of-right FAR wiring - as its own bounded research + rules + presentation tasks. It does not displace the current M5-T032 packet or the spatial diagnosis.
requirements.required_harness: Task contracting order in the ledger.
